name: linkedin-ai-reply-assistant
description: Chrome extension that provides AI-generated reply suggestions for LinkedIn posts and comments

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --mode content && node scripts/verify-build.js && node scripts/smoke-test.js && node scripts/prompt-test.js
scripts.build:prod: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode production && vite build --mode content && node scripts/verify-build.js && node scripts/smoke-test.js && node scripts/prompt-test.js
